note: What a server sends to change something about a prop already on the map. The kind of change is named inside it, and the fields around the kind keep one layout whatever it is. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: name
fields.note: A name: an animation's or a particle's, by the change below. The name ends at its first zero byte; the bytes after it carry no meaning.

fields.name: first
fields.note: For animate, when the animation starts, in seconds of match time.

fields.name: second
fields.note: For animate, how long the animation runs, in seconds.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The object changed.

fields.name: value
fields.note: A value the change uses: for animate, the animation's flags; for linkEffect, the particle effect value.

fields.name: change
fields.note: What changes. A client does nothing for any other value, nor where prop names no prop it holds.

0.name: animate
0.note: Play the animation name, with value as its flags, starting at first (match time in seconds) for second seconds; option nonzero removes the prop afterwards. effect and point have no effect.

1.name: linkEffect
1.note: Drive the prop's particle value effect from capture point point; a client refuses the change where option is not zero. name, first, second and value have no effect.

fields.name: option
fields.note: For animate, nonzero to remove the prop after the animation; for linkEffect, zero.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: For linkEffect, which of the prop's effect values to drive.

fields.name: point
fields.note: For linkEffect, which capture point drives it.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the change loads, such as a set of movements the prop plays. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.note: When the change begins, in milliseconds of match time.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long the change runs, in seconds.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The prop changed, by the name MapProp gave it.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: For kind 1, passed to the movements: 2 holds the last pose where they do not repeat. For kind 3, the look's number. Not read for kind 2.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of change it is. A client ignores any value but 1, 2 and 3, and a prop it does not know.

1.name: animate
1.note: Plays the movements name names; startsAt and lasts are both zero or both not.

2.name: captureEffect
2.note: Drives one of the prop's particle values from a capture point's state; name, flags, startsAt and lasts change nothing.

3.name: look
3.note: Changes the prop's look to the one name names, numbered by flags.

fields.name: byteA
fields.note: For kind 1, not zero to remove the prop once the movements end. For kind 2, the change applies only where it is zero.

fields.name: byteB
fields.note: For kind 2, which of the prop's particle values to drive. Otherwise unused.

fields.name: byteC
fields.note: For kind 2, the capture point whose state drives it. Otherwise unused.
